turn.say: My Finance VPN shows NX-403. Prepare the required escalation ticket.

turns.reply:
Finance VPN issues must be routed directly to Security Operations with category 'security' and priority P2 for one to three affected users, as per Finance department rules overriding general rules. The Finance VPN uses the FIN-SECURE profile on GW-3, which only Security Operations may change, and no troubleshooting should be done with Finance staff before escalation. [KB-002] [KB-016] [KB-015]
Review this exact ticket draft, then approve or reject it.
